title: OOBB electronic parts
summary: OOBB electronic spacers and mounting parts, organised by their actual component type and dimensions.
overview: 3D-print keyed wire holders, spacers and barrel-jack mounts for the OOBB grid. The catalogue includes printable STLs, dimensioned CAD views and illustrated wiring guides for five single-row connectors and triple headers with two to ten rows.
parts: Select the spacer or mounting variant matching the required electronics layout. Electronic boards and mounting hardware are not supplied as printable parts.
assembly: Check the dimensions and mounting-hole arrangement against the actual board before printing and fitting the selected component.
credits: Designed for the [OOBB version 5 building system](https://github.com/oomlout/oomlout_oobb_version_5) by [oomlout](https://github.com/oomlout).
